_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 33: 14-20 November 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He refers back to what happened with Charlie Kirk in September, misdating it to August first, and says it takes a lot to turn a cruise ship and that is what they are doing right now through prayer.
mentions.quote: it takes a lot to turn a cruise ship
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a claim that prayer is slowly turning the national direction.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he is done with those who have touched children, and that a new transmitted disease will come with an infection causing painful and disfiguring damage to them.
mentions.quote: there would be a new transmitted disease
mentions.falsify_match: A newly identified sexually transmitted infection reported in the medical literature.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears. No date is given, so it cannot come due.

mentions.claim_text: He says things are speeding up and can be felt, that there is an urgency in the air, and asks not only whether listeners know him but whether he knows them.
mentions.quote: There's an urgency in the air
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a felt sense of acceleration.

mentions.claim_text: He describes being in the Swiss Alps, going through the towns and knocking on the door of each small place, with people going in and alerting them that a great revival is about to come upon them.
mentions.quote: in the Swiss Alps and I'm going in the towns
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival in Alpine Switzerland.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported, though no date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is adding to the body one day at a time, taking people out and bringing people in, and that it is like a march.
mentions.quote: He's adding to the body one day at a time. It's a march
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: continuous unspecified growth.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will know his son, and tells listeners to ask the Holy Spirit to make them a greater witnessing tool and a voice piece so that he can flow within and they can add to the march.
mentions.quote: Ask the Holy Spirit to help you to become a greater witnessing tool
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that a baby will be born and the grandmother raise it, that the daughter would change her heart, and that even if she does not she would not abort but perhaps give the child up for adoption.
mentions.quote: the baby will be born and let the grandma raise it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable from outside: a private family outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says you have to pray, that God develops you as you intercede and grow so you go from glory to glory, and describes the anointing and presence being strong while he prayed that day.
mentions.quote: God will develop you and you'll go from glory to glory
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says the church must not be asleep but wake up, closing out 2025 and coming alive in 2026 even more, and that he has a great warning going into the future.
mentions.quote: closing out 2025 and really really coming alive in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no measure of a church being awake is given.

mentions.claim_text: He says the canopy was back with the blue and the colours and the sound he could hear, that they are almost there, that this dispensation of grace is coming to an end and the tribulation is about to begin.
mentions.quote: This dispensation of grace is coming to an end
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation begins.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, but with no date attached nothing comes due. This has been said since the channel began.

mentions.claim_text: He says these things are about to take place and to keep watching an escalation, and that the Lord told him about 2026 as he prays into it that they will have to contend.
mentions.quote: about 2026 he said you'll have to contend
mentions.falsify_match: A contentious 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Contend is not defined, so effectively nothing can miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says where the plague comes in is the fall or winter of 2027, and corrects those who say he predicted a plague now, insisting he said there is a window of opportunity before then.
mentions.quote: where the plague will come in is the fall winter of 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A significant epidemic beginning in late 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will share more about 2026 and what was said about black swan events, the red dawn experiences and impeachment.
mentions.quote: about black swan events, the red dawn experiences, impeachment
mentions.falsify_match: Red dawn events, black swans and impeachment attempts in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None of them. Red dawn is not defined here.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2025 will finish strong with six weeks left, and that in 2026 they will have financial breakthrough as a nation and will not go over the waterfall edge no matter how it looks.
mentions.quote: in 2026 we will have financial breakthrough as a nation
mentions.falsify_match: A clear national financial improvement in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A downturn. Breakthrough is undefined, which is the usual problem.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the Swiss Alps sight: going through the towns, knocking on the door of each small place, alerting them that a great revival is about to come upon them.
mentions.quote: in the Swiss Alps and I'm going in the towns
mentions.falsify_match: Same as the 19 November telling.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the Lord is adding to the body one day at a time, taking people out and bringing people in, like a march.
mentions.quote: He's adding to the body one day at a time. It's a march
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that they will know his son and that listeners should ask to become a greater witnessing tool and a voice piece so they add to the march.
mentions.quote: become of greater witnessing tool for him. A voice piece
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the prayer that the baby be born and the grandmother raise it, that the daughter change her heart, and that failing that she not abort but consider adoption.
mentions.quote: the baby will be born and let the grandma raise it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable from outside.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Antichrist will deceive people in the days ahead by looking polished and beautiful and feeling great, and asks how many will surrender themselves to him just because of that.
mentions.quote: The Antichrist will look really polished and beautiful
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in any near term: the figure is not named and no date is given.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord used the words that a cold war will become even colder and that is what to focus on now, and says he saw Kim and asked the Lord why they did not pick on him as much.
mentions.quote: cold war will become even colder
mentions.falsify_match: A visible deterioration in relations short of open war.
mentions.falsify_miss: Warming relations. Which cold war is meant is not said.

mentions.claim_text: He says not everybody will see but everybody will hear, citing that his sheep know his voice and will not follow a stranger, and that every born again Christian can hear the father though some may never see visions.
mentions.quote: Not everybody's going to see, but everybody will hear
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it widens the claim of prophetic hearing to the whole audience.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the Lord spoke to him about getting vitamin D3 levels up, saying it applies from November to March.
mentions.quote: he said from November to March
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: an instruction, not an outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says he tries to make things clear, does not want prophetic confusion or to bring static into the prophetic community, and wants clarity, authenticity and humility.
mentions.quote: I don't want prophetic confusion
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated, but it is a standard the rest of the corpus can be measured against.

mentions.claim_text: He says things will manifest concerning JD Vance and reports the Lord naming Marilyn Monroe, Monica Lewinsky and telling him to remember JFK and not forget it, adding that he finds it heavy because he wants the Republicans to win.
mentions.quote: the Lord said Marilyn Monroe, Monica Lewinsky, remember JFK
mentions.falsify_match: A sexual scandal or entrapment attempt involving Vance.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. The three names are the whole of the content; he does not spell out the warning.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Harvard written out in bricks lined up like a brick house in Harvard letters, and notes the man did not go to Harvard but to Yale.
mentions.quote: I saw Harvard and I saw it was in bricks
mentions.falsify_match: Something connecting the man to Harvard.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing does. Notable because he reports the sight not matching the fact and says so rather than adjusting it.

mentions.claim_text: He settles on the word charisma after being given it by someone present, and says he wants to tell Candace that God has a hand on her, adding that they pray into these things and he had no idea beforehand.
mentions.quote: I want to tell that Candace lady, God has a hand on you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a blessing with no outcome attached.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told there are not just a couple more minutes in the game but that the best was saved for last, that there may be two minutes left and they are down by one while everything seems to be going against them.
mentions.quote: No, but I saved the best for last
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a metaphor of lateness with no clock attached to it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord redeems time and heals, and that he was shown thanksgiving babies, giving thanks for offspring.
mentions.quote: he showed me have thanksgiving babies
mentions.falsify_match: Reported conceptions among listeners, which any large audience supplies.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying listeners will be so thankful and grateful in the days ahead that they have Trump, that they may not agree with all his decisions, but that for what is coming they will be grateful he is president.
mentions.quote: you'll be so grateful that he is president
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: gratitude is not an observable outcome, and it doubles as a pre-emptive defence of decisions the audience dislikes.
